# DataMatrix Generator (dmgen)

> Commercial C++20 library that generates DataMatrix ECC 200 symbols per ISO/IEC 16022 (GOST R ISO/IEC 16022), with validation against the GS1 General Specifications and the Chestny ZNAK (Russian product marking) profile, and outputs PNG or JPEG for marking print. Static C++ API, flat C ABI (`dmgen_c`), Python package (`pip install libscanner-dmgen`, `import dmgen`) and the `dmgen` command-line tool, for Windows x64 and Linux (x86-64, ARM64, ARMv7). All 24 square sizes, six encodation schemes; every symbol is read back by the library itself before it is returned. The public C++ API does not throw: anything that can fail returns `Result<T>`. This repository holds the public headers, examples and license texts — no library source; prebuilt packages are in GitHub Releases. The library runs a trial period (one month from the first run on a machine, no network needed); after that a license from https://libscanner.com is required.

The public headers are the authoritative API reference: every type, field and function is commented in English. Read them before writing code against the library.

## API reference (headers in this repository)

- [include/dmgen/Dmgen.h](include/dmgen/Dmgen.h): umbrella header — includes the whole C++ API
- [include/dmgen/Encoder.h](include/dmgen/Encoder.h): `dmgen::encode(data, options)` → `Result<Symbol>`
- [include/dmgen/Options.h](include/dmgen/Options.h): encoding options (size, scheme, GS1 mode)
- [include/dmgen/Gs1.h](include/dmgen/Gs1.h): validation of a string against GS1 and the Chestny ZNAK profile
- [include/dmgen/Symbol.h](include/dmgen/Symbol.h): symbol sizes and the assembled symbol
- [include/dmgen/Image.h](include/dmgen/Image.h): symbol raster, PNG and JPEG
- [include/dmgen/Result.h](include/dmgen/Result.h): `Result<T>` — a value or an error
- [include/dmgen/License.h](include/dmgen/License.h): trial and license status, activation
- [include/dmgen/Version.h](include/dmgen/Version.h): library version
- [include/dmgen/dmgen_c.h](include/dmgen/dmgen_c.h): the flat C ABI (`dmgen_c` shared library) — for C, MSVC, C#, Go, Delphi and other languages

## Examples

- [examples/cpp/main.cpp](examples/cpp/main.cpp): C++, static linking ([build notes](examples/cpp/README.md), [meson.build](examples/cpp/meson.build))
- [examples/c/main.c](examples/c/main.c): C via the C ABI ([build notes](examples/c/README.md))
- [examples/python/example.py](examples/python/example.py): Python package
- [examples/cli/README.md](examples/cli/README.md): the `dmgen` command-line tool
